verdict: Not a site outage: two selector mistakes in the product specs, one smoke test pointed at an unresolvable host, and one page-load flake; no product bugs shown.

failures.test: Product extras › opening an accordion item reveals its content
failures.summary: The test clicks a heading named 'Free Worldwide Shipping', but the page names it 'Free Shipping Worldwide'.
failures.evidence: Error: "waiting for getByRole('heading', { name: 'Free Worldwide Shipping' })". Snapshot under region "Product details": heading "Free Shipping Worldwide" [level=3].
failures.next_step: In product-extras.spec.ts:33, change the heading name to 'Free Shipping Worldwide' (or check with content whether the copy changed on purpose), then confirm the /^Every order ships free/ body text still matches.

failures.test: Product info › selecting a colour updates the stock for the selected size
failures.summary: The test uses variant id 'colour-yellow', but the colour option is Mustard; the next test in the same file uses 'colour-mustard'.
failures.evidence: Error: "waiting for locator('#colour-yellow')". Snapshot group "Select colour": radios Sage, Charcoal, Mustard, Lime, Pink, with no yellow.
failures.next_step: In product-info.spec.ts:21-22, change variantButton("colour-yellow") to variantButton("colour-mustard").

failures.test: Smoke: site health › home page renders with site chrome
failures.summary: The smoke spec navigates to http://novera-web.internal:3100/, which does not resolve; every other test uses localhost:3100.
failures.next_step: Find where the smoke spec gets its base URL (env var or site profile for novera) and point it at http://localhost:3100, or add a DNS/hosts entry for novera-web.internal.

failures.test: Product extras › the size chart switches between inches and centimetres
failures.summary: Page load in beforeEach timed out on the first attempt; the test passed on retry.
failures.evidence: outcome "flaky", attempts 2; first error: "page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded. navigating to \"http://localhost:3100/\", waiting until \"load\"".
failures.next_step: Watch for repeat goto timeouts on localhost:3100; if they recur, check the local server's cold-start time or use waitUntil 'domcontentloaded' in gotoProduct.
